name: Infused Brawler (CR 1/3)
body:
INFUSED BRAWLER
CR 1/3

XP 135
Infused brawler (titan) 1
LN Medium humanoid (aether, human)
Init +2; Senses Perception +5

DEFENSE

AC 18, touch 12, flat-footed 16 (+6 armor, +2 Dex)
hp 12 (1d10+2)
Fort +3, Ref +4, Will +0
Immune aetherite radiation

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft. (20 ft. in armor)
Melee unarmed strike +5 (1d6+3) or brawler’s flurry +3/+3 (1d6+3), Ranged combat shotgun +4 touch (1d6) or combat shotgun semi-automatic fire +2/+2 touch (1d6)
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 1st; concentration +4)

At will—mage hand, open/close
1/day—shield

Special Attacks grit (1)

STATISTICS

Str 16, Dex 14, Con 12, Int 10, Wis 12, Cha 14
Base Atk +1; CMB +4; CMD 16
Feats Arcane StrikeB, Improved Unarmed StrikeB, Unholstering Strike
Skills Acrobatics +6, Diplomacy +2, Intimidate +3, Perception +5, Sense Motive +4
Languages Hymnas
SQ brawler‘s cunning, martial training, psychic bond (DC 13; 5 bonds), telekinetic guidance (15 ft.), Combat Gear potion of cure light wounds, combat shotgun (24 bullets), trooper armor, aetheric capacitor (12 au)

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Deeds

The Infused Brawler can spend grit points to accomplish deeds. The Infused Brawler has access to the following deeds and gains 1 point of grit back every time she scores a critical hit with a firearm or lands a killing blow with a firearm.

Unstoppable (Ex)

When The Infused Brawler succeeds at a Fortitude saving throw against an effect that deals damage on a successful save, she can spend 1 grit point as an immediate action to instead take no damage for that effect.

Hail of Bullets (Ex)

When The Infused Brawler makes a brawler’s flurry she can exchange one melee attack for a ranged attack with a firearm. Such ranged attacks suffer the normal attack penalty of brawler’s flurry. The Infused Brawler can exchange a maximum of 3 melee attacks for firearm attacks per day.

Psychic Bond (Su)

The Infused Brawler can forge a psychic bond with another creature that has the aether subtype. Creating this bond requires both creatures remain in physical contact for 1 minute. An unwilling target of psychic bond may negate the effect with a successful Will save (DC 11). After a successful bond, both creatures gain a +4 racial bonus on Sense Motive checks made against one another and a +4 racial bonus on Bluff checks made to pass secret messages. Once per day, The Infused Brawler can share thoughts with one or more creatures she is psychically bonded with as though they are all under the effect of mindlink. The Infused Brawler can be bonded with a maximum of 5 creatures at once.

Telekinetic Guidance (Su)

When in zero gravity (or affected by levitate) The Infused Brawler gains a fly speed equal to half her base speed.
